name: Empty
summary: What a screen shows when there is nothing to show. It states the fact, and when there is a way out of it, it says what that way is.
summaryZh: 屏幕上没有东西可显示时的样子。它说清楚这个事实,有路可走的时候,也把那条路说清楚。

parts.name: Art
parts.note: The round plate the illustration sits in.

slots.name: art
slots.description: The illustration. It goes in `.um-empty__art`; a decorative one is hidden from the screen reader.
slots.descriptionZh: 插图,放在 `.um-empty__art` 里;纯装饰的插图要对读屏隐藏。

slots.name: image
slots.description: The illustration, under the name Element Plus gives it. It fills the same part as the art slot and wins when both are given.
slots.descriptionZh: 插图,用的是 Element Plus 的叫法。它和图形插槽填的是同一块,两个都给时以它为准。

slots.name: description
slots.description: The line under the illustration, under the name Element Plus gives it. It fills the same part as the title slot and wins when both are given.
slots.descriptionZh: 插图下面那一行文字,用的是 Element Plus 的叫法。它和标题插槽填的是同一块,两个都给时以它为准。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The loose text under the headline.
slots.descriptionZh: 标题下面散着的那段文字。

a11y.notes: The empty state is a message, not a picture: the title is the message and it has to be real text. The art is decoration, so mark it aria-hidden and the screen reader will not read out a stray character. When the empty state appears because the reader changed a filter, wrap it in role="status" so the change is announced; when it was there when the page loaded, it needs no live region.
a11y.notesZh: 空状态是一句话,不是一张图:标题才是那句话,而且必须是真文字。图形只是装饰,加上 aria-hidden,读屏才不会把里面的字符念出来。空状态是因为读者改了筛选条件才出现的,就把它放进 role="status" 里,变化才会被播报;页面加载时它就在那儿的话,不需要 live region。

examples.title: Empty
examples.description: The art sits in a round plate the mood paints, so it takes the placeholder colour and never competes with the message.
examples.descriptionZh: 图形待在一个由 mood 画的圆盘里,所以它取的是占位色,不会跟正文抢注意力。
examples.markup: ∅ Nothing here yet Items will show up once they arrive.

examples.title: Without the art
examples.description: The art is optional; the title is not. An empty state without a headline is just a gap on the page.
examples.descriptionZh: 图形可有可无,标题不行。没有标题的空状态就只是页面上一段空白。
examples.markup: No results Try a different search term.

notes: The empty state is text the reader can act on. The library paints the plate, the colour and the spacing; what is missing, and what to do about it, is written by the host.
notesZh: 空状态是读者能拿来行动的几句话。圆盘、颜色和间距由库里来画;缺的是什么、接下来怎么办,由使用它的页面来写。
